gold.user: As a project manager, I want to update multiple custom field values for several issues in one request, so that I can save time and ensure consistency across the issues.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a JSON payload containing an array of issue IDs and their corresponding custom field values, and return a success message with the updated values.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to update a specific custom field value for a single issue, so that I can reflect the latest status of the task in Jira.
gold.ideal: The API should allow me to specify the field ID or key and the new value, and return the updated field value along with a confirmation of the change.
